Cost-robustness check revealed that momentum under realistic costs (commission_per_trade=2.0, commission_per_share=0.003, slippage_cents=2.0, slippage_proportional=0.0005) shows CONSISTENT_WITH_NOISE_COST on only 2 assets (JNJ, XOM) and REGIME_STABLE_COST on 8 assets, with no REGIME_DEPENDENT_COST or REGIME_STABLE_LOSS_COST. This suggests the positive momentum edge may not survive realistic transaction costs, reducing uncertainty about cost robustness.

Evidence shows that 8 out of 10 assets (80%) demonstrate consistent positive edges under the past-only volatility gate, while the remaining 2 show either no edge or edge in only specific regimes.
